title: RCA Android TV, RC50A21S-4KSM (Toptech/Zeasn firmware, Realtek RTD2851P)
notes:
RCA Android TV, RC50A21S-4KSM (Toptech/Zeasn firmware, Realtek RTD2851P)
Android TV 9 (API 28), firmware RTK2851P eng.tianju.20210703.181325 (userdebug, release-keys)
ro.product.model=SmartTV  ro.product.device=SmartTV  ro.product.manufacturer=Q010
ro.board.platform=rtd285o  ro.product.board=mac6p  ~1.5 GB RAM, armeabi-v7a userspace
Fingerprint: Realtek/RealtekATV/RealtekATV:9/RTK2851P/tianjunyong07031813:userdebug/release-keys
The model properties are generic (SmartTV / SMARTPHONE): match on the build id and board, not the name.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/rca-rc50a21s-4ksm/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/rca-rc50a21s-4ksm/debloat.txt com.zeasn.rca.toptech
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.zeasn.rca.toptech (Zeasn). Android's FallbackHome is the only other HOME.
No Live TV app with a leanback entry point: tuner and inputs live in com.toptech.tvmenu (keep it).
The saved Wi-Fi network belongs to android.uid.system; no setupwraith on this build.

Leave alone: com.toptech.* (tvmenu = input panel and TV player, tv.service, keyboard_seven,
setupwizard, systemupdate, tvfactory, factorytools), com.realtek.* (dtv, tv.atv, tv.passthrough = HDMI/AV/
VGA/YPbPr inputs, providers.tv), com.hikeen.actiontest. Do not launch the factory packages.
Kept by choice on the test set: Google Assistant (katniss), firmware updates (com.toptech.systemupdate),
AirPlay/EShare/DLNA (com.ecloud.*), Miracast (com.rtk.android.miracast), USB media player, photo screensaver.

Applied 2026-10-21 on one set and used for two days, through several reboots and power off/on: nothing came
back enabled, Home stayed on the reference launcher, Wi-Fi and Ethernet reconnect. Not a longer soak yet.
See README.md in this folder for the Inputs panel, the Input key and the ADB notes.
Zeasn ad portal, store and background services
